lines.en: Head down, I follow the roots.

lines.zh: 短腿踩着落叶，一步步挪。
lines.en: Short legs step through fallen leaves.
I drag along. I am not much of a runner.
I hunt for tender shoots in the wood.
My tail keeps me level.

lines.zh: 枯木挡路，我从上面跨过去。
lines.en: A dead log blocks me; I step over it.

lines.zh: 林子很密，我走得很小心。
lines.en: The wood is dense. I move carefully.
I sniff as I go.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，拨开一根枝。
lines.en: I lift a foreclaw and push a branch aside.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，隔着几步。
lines.en: I trail a few steps behind my companions.

lines.zh: 我从一个土堆上跨过去。
lines.en: I step over a mound of earth.
I search for mushrooms among the roots.
My toes grip the wet soil.
Standing, my head never settles.
I nibble a fern frond.

lines.zh: 树冠太密，我找不到太阳。
lines.en: The canopy is too thick; I cannot find the sun.
My nose works at the ground.
I listen under the leaf litter.
A few of my kind are nearby.
I grind it bite by bite.
I rest in a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水落到我背上。
lines.en: Water from a leaf lands on my back.
I shake a leg.

lines.zh: 我低头啃着蕨叶，耳朵没停。
lines.en: I keep chewing ferns, but my ears never rest.

lines.zh: 我在等别的鹿角龙走开。
lines.en: I wait for others to move aside.
This shoot is hard to bite through.
I have no big teeth in my mouth.
You are standing behind a trunk.
I have never seen you before.

lines.zh: 我得抬起长脖子才看得见你。
lines.en: I have to lift my long neck to see you.
I am eating this moss.
If you charge, I will dodge.
Your steps make the ground sound.
Several of us are nearby.
Look at my hands. Very small.
I will not bite first.
You are blocking my ferns.
There is no shortage of food here.
Just walk away slowly.
I limped a long way back.
A gash on my hind leg.
I am down on the leaf litter.
My hide is cut; I can still run.
I glance back at my companions.
I need to slip back into the ferns.
Breath short and shallow — I can't run far.
Do not harm me again.
Is this tender leafage?
It smells like fresh shoots.
Set it on the leaf litter.
I eat only plants.
That grass in your hand. For me.
Push it toward me.
I cannot reach that high.
That will last me a while.
You brushed against my back.
I shuffled back a stretch.
Short legs. I am unsteady.
My tail keeps me balanced.
That bump was all right.
You are much stronger than I.
The ground is very slick.
I step aside.
Could you go around me?
I already have a mate in the group.
I must check the surroundings first.
Wait for this rain to stop.
Sniff my neck first, then come closer.
I must get back to the group.
Ask again after this season.
Come back to the herd with me.
The ferns I pick are the tenderest.
I hold this tender leaf in the corner of my mouth.
This much grass will do.
I dropped a piece.
I lean in and sniff.
Not mine. I put it down.
I will keep this piece.
Leave my food alone.
I'll take it back for the herd to gnaw.
A noise by the roots.
Now I lift my neck.
I caught movement.
I retreat toward the ferns.
All four legs are loaded.
I have my eye on you now.
Several of us are watching.
The ground is trembling faintly.
You came too close.
I need to run.
Get behind that tree.
I count three breaths.
Move, and I run.
I am off at a run.
I watch where your feet land.
I have backed to the ferns.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上一大片。
lines.en: Your shadow covers a lot of ground.
I need not fight. Running is enough.
The leaves keep rustling.
There is dense cover over there.
You turned your head away.
Any closer and I slip in.
I press down into the litter.
My heart is hammering.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的那一刻，我冲了。
lines.en: The moment you bend over, I charge.
I am running now.
Do not follow.
I am into the ferns.
It is very dark here.
A foreclaw rakes your leg.
My kick goes wide and only grazes you.
I grab cloth, not flesh.
Step back and I let go.
My head butts your shin.
Then I run off.
I bite clumsily, but my teeth are sharp.
That will let me get away.
One more shove, and you step back.
I swing my tail and kick with a hind leg.
These teeth of mine are blunt.
I am still panting.
That is that.
The light in the wood is broken.
I take a bite of fern first.
A few of my kind live here.
I shake the leaves off my back.
I do not move quickly.
The trees are too tall to see the top.
The smell of rotting leaves is strong.
I'm small in the forest, but I bolt early.
A line of prints on the ground.
I duck through.
The ferns will cover me.
Walking slowly. The grass rustles.
A noise comes from far off.
I should find my companions.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶里探出小脑袋。
lines.en: I poke my small head out of the ferns.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，焦了一块。
lines.en: Fire singes a patch of my back.
I roll down an earthen slope.
Water over my back, no footing left.
The blast throws the leaves up.
An arrow sticks in my hind leg.
The light makes me dizzy.
There are not enough shoots here.

lines.zh: 闪电照得整片林子发白。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the whole wood.
No trees below. No ground.
